verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs explicitly describe delegating tasks to a built-in AI agent that can plan, code, run tests, and even work autonomously in the background or fleets ('Accelerate development by handing off tasks to Cursor', 'Agents use their own computers to build, test, and demo features'), directly matching the story of task delegation to a built-in assistant. Community evidence corroborates real daily usage, though it also notes buggy edges unrelated to delegation itself. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of delegation/agent task completion quality, and clearer boundaries on autonomy limits.
